newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Taxi boss dies, driver hurt in S.African shooting.
newsitem.headline: Taxi boss dies, driver hurt in S.African shooting.

text.p: A South African taxi boss was killed and his driver seriously injured in a shooting outside a hotel in Johannesburg's upmarket Sandton suburb on Thursday, police said.

Dixon Mampane, president of the South African Long Distance Taxi Association, and his as yet unidentified driver had stopped at a traffic light after leaving a hotel about 3 p.m. (1300 GMT) when a second car pulled up alongside.
A number of gunmen opened fire on Mampane's car before fleeing. Another car then stopped and once again shots were fired in Mampane's direction, police said.
Mampane died on the scene after being hit in the neck. His driver was taken to hospital in a serious condition.
Several AK-47, 9mm and 7.65mm cartridges were found on the scene. An inquiry into the shooting is being led by the police service's Serious Offences Investigation Unit.
Nothing was missing from the car and police said they believed the shooting was related to taxi feuding.
